blocks.text: Hydrocarbons organic compounds ki aik class hai jin mein sirf carbon aur hydrogen hote hain. Hydrocarbons petroleum aur natural gas mein bohat zyada milte hain. Yeh aksar gharon aur industry mein fuel (indhan) ke taur par istemal hote hain. Hydrocarbons se bohat si cheezen banai (synthesise) jati hain. Unsaturated hydrocarbons, khaas taur par alkenes, bohat se industrial products banane ke liye starting material (shuru ka maal) hain. Dawaiyan, plastics, perfumes aur polymers jaisi zyada tar cheezen hydrocarbons hi se banti hain. Hydrocarbons do bari classes mein bante hain: aliphatic aur aromatic hydrocarbons.

blocks.title: Aliphatic hydrocarbons
blocks.text: Jo compounds aromatic nahi hote unhen aliphatic kehte hain. Aliphatic compounds open chain (khuli zanjeer) bhi ho sakte hain aur cyclic (halqa) bhi, aur saturated bhi ho sakte hain aur unsaturated bhi. Agar aliphatic compound mein sirf carbon aur hydrogen atoms hon to use aliphatic hydrocarbon kehte hain.

Alkanes acyclic (bina halqe wale) aliphatic hydrocarbons hain, jabke cycloalkanes cyclic (halqe wale) aliphatic hydrocarbons hain. Alkenes aur alkynes acyclic aur unsaturated aliphatic hydrocarbons hain. Figure 11.1 mein aliphatic hydrocarbons ki kuch misalein hain.

blocks.alt: Aath aliphatic hydrocarbons ki saakht naamon ke saath. Oopar: methane, ethane, ethene aur ethyne, har bond dikhaya gaya; ethene mein C=C double bond aur ethyne mein H-C triple bond C-H. Neeche: cyclopropane, cyclobutane, cyclopentane aur cyclohexane, CH2 groups ke halqe (H2C, CH2 ya H2 ke saath C likha).
blocks.caption: Figure 11.1: Aliphatic hydrocarbons (kitab ki Figure 11.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Aromatic hydrocarbons cyclic hydrocarbons ki aik khaas class hai jin mein hydrogen ke muqable mein carbon zyada hota hai (high carbon to hydrogen ratio), aur jo benzene (C₆H₆) ya us jaise compounds par based hain. Benzene bunyadi aromatic compound hai; toluene aur phenol jaise compounds us ke derivatives (us se bane compounds) hain. Figure 11.2 mein kuch aromatic hydrocarbons ki structures hain.

blocks.alt: Teen chhe-rukni halqe jin mein single aur double bonds baari baari aate hain, konon par HC, CH aur C: benzene (halqe ke oopar aur neeche H), methylbenzene (oopar wale carbon par CH3) aur ethylbenzene (oopar wale carbon par CH2-CH3).
blocks.caption: Figure 11.2: Kuch aromatic hydrocarbons (kitab ki Figure 11.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Benzene ke halqe ke har kone par aik carbon hai; HC ya CH ka matlab hai us carbon par aik hydrogen. Single aur double bonds baari baari (alternate) dikhaye gaye hain. Methylbenzene aur ethylbenzene mein oopar wale carbon ka hydrogen CH₃ ya CH₂–CH₃ group se badal gaya hai, is liye wahan H nahi likha.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 11.2 mein ethylbenzene ke halqe ka oopar daen wala bond toota hua chhapa hai. Benzene ka halqa hamesha poora (chhe carbon, band halqa) hota hai, is liye oopar diagram mein poora halqa banaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information!
blocks.text: Lafz aromatic Greek lafz ‘aroma’ se aaya hai jis ka matlab hai “khushboodar” (fragrant). Organic chemistry mein yeh compounds ki aik khaas class (aromatic compounds) ke liye istemal hota hai jin ki apni khaas boo (odour) hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Aliphatic aur aromatic hydrocarbons mein farq batayein, aur cyclohexane, ethyne aur toluene ki class batayein (exercise Q.2b).
blocks.explanation: Aliphatic hydrocarbons benzene ke halqe par based nahi hote: open chain ya cyclic, saturated ya unsaturated. Cyclohexane cyclic saturated aliphatic hydrocarbon hai aur ethyne acyclic unsaturated aliphatic hydrocarbon. Aromatic hydrocarbons mein benzene ka halqa hota hai aur carbon zyada hota hai: toluene (methylbenzene) aromatic hai.

items: Hydrocarbons: sirf C aur H; petroleum aur natural gas mein milte hain; fuel hain; alkenes industry ka starting material hain.
Aliphatic = aromatic nahi (alkanes acyclic, cycloalkanes cyclic, alkenes aur alkynes unsaturated). Aromatic = benzene par based halqe, carbon zyada (benzene, toluene, ethylbenzene).
